_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (0% directional movement in 35 windows) demands HOLD as the honest default — the breaker is a Fear-Greed cross above 38 into Denial, but until that fires, the score is statistically pinned.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both lean bullish on the rotation thesis but the Analyst explicitly hedges with low conviction while the Narrative frames it as imminent; neither provides a confirmed trigger yet.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear-Greed crosses above 38 with BTC momentum holding >50 and ETF flows sustaining >90
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear-Greed drops below 25 or VIX spikes >20 with funding turning negative
